purpose: Pins the intent-router pre-release AWA is proven against, and the EXACT router contract-version strings the seam test asserts. Neither repo's own CI tests the router<->AWA seam; this pin + engine/tests/test_consumer_seam.py is that test. A router contract-version bump (v1 -> v2) or a rename MUST break the seam test.

router.install_note: Point the router at this ref so `import intent_router` resolves — a clone of KleinPerkins/intent-router checked out at `ref` (main) on PYTHONPATH, or `pip install -e <clone>`. base_sha f44dbadd is the router-main commit that FROZE intent-proposal/v1 (the merge of router PR #4; `git show f44dbadd:contracts/intent-proposal.v1.json` shows status:frozen). Locally the seam test SKIPS (never fails) when the router is not importable — the kernel-first / off-switch property (make verify passes router-uninstalled). The dedicated CI seam job (.github/workflows/ci.yml job `router-seam`) co-installs the router at this ref and runs the seam NON-skipped with AWA_SEAM_REQUIRE_ROUTER=1, so a future router contract drift (v1->v2 / unfreeze / rename) turns AWA CI red instead of silently skipping.

expected_constitution_checks_note: The `egress` constitution machine-check is expected ACTIVE (flipped from spec) now that the system-wide operator egress gate is enforced across all seven PM-facing surfaces. AWA's side is authoritatively declared + enforced in consumer/egress-gate.v1.json (machine-checked by make verify, router-uninstalled). The router-side byte-flip of machine_checks.egress in intent-constitution/v1 is the cross-repo counterpart: the seam test asserts it WHEN the router declares that machine-check (so a router still on `spec` turns the co-installed seam job red), and is a no-op if the router constitution does not (yet) carry a machine_checks map.
assertions: the router's authoritative catalog-verify passes AWA's real catalog with zero Tier A/B/C banned terms
AWA's egress-terms snapshot is a superset of the router's composed Tier A/B tiers (drift guard)
IF the router constitution declares machine_checks, its `egress` check == 'active' (cross-repo flip enforcement)
